title: MBAPPÉ vs YAMAL! World Cup Final Spot on the Line
byline: The FIFA World Cup 2026 reaches its biggest showdown yet as France and Spain clash in a blockbuster semi-final with a place in the final at stake. Kylian Mbappé’s free-scoring France face Lamine Yamal’s European champions in a battle between two of football’s brightest stars and leading title contenders.

title: CID seeks Health Ministry probe into substandard cardiac devices
byline: The Criminal Investigation Department (CID) has requested the Health Ministry Secretary to conduct a preliminary inquiry to identify the individuals and companies responsible for the alleged procurement of substandard cardiac stents and angiogram catheters supplied to hospitals, and to facilitate legal action, Doctors’ Trade Union Alliance for Medical and Civil Rights Chairman Specialist Dr Chamal Sanjeewa said.

title: Quadruple murder accused acquitted after 16 years
byline: An accused who stood indicted with quadruple murder was found not guilty and acquitted by North Central Province High Court Judge Indika Attanayake. The case had been pending for 16 years.

title: Magistrates, District Court judges up in arms against move
byline: With pressure mounting on the Government from the country’s legal fraternity over the move for retirement age extension for Superior Court judges, the Judicial Service Association of Sri Lanka (JSASL), the sole organisation representing all District Court Judges and Magistrates in the country, has informed President Anura Kumara Dissanayake that it had unanimously passed a resolution opposing such extension for any judge.

title: Norway turn World Cup heartbreak into celebration as huge crowds pack capital
byline: More than 100,000 fans flooded the streets of the Norwegian capital Oslo on ​Monday to give their soccer team a heroes’ welcome, turning the heartbreak of their World Cup exit into a ‌massive national celebration.

title: Govt. silence masks Rs 31 Bn cyber heist
byline: Over US$ 88 million and 4 million Euros have been siphoned from Sri Lanka’s state coffers due to severe institutional negligence, a loss masked by official state silence until a recent Committee on Public Finance (CoPF) report exposed the crisis, according to an analytical article by Independent Researcher Dr Sanjana Hattotuwa.

title: Deadline set for school stationery grant process; No further extensions
byline: The Education Ministry has announced the deadlines for the 2026 programme to provide grants for the purchase of stationery for schoolchildren, stating that no further extensions will be granted.

title: Filipino woman arrested at BIA with Rs. 61.8 mn worth of ’Kush’
byline: A 63-year-old Filipino woman was arrested at Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA), Katunayake, in the early hours of today after Airport Police Narcotics Bureau officers allegedly seized ’’Kush’’ drugs worth an estimated Rs. 61.8 million from her luggage.

title: Grandfather arrested over rape
byline: A 12-year-old schoolgirl suffering from a urine infection was examined by the doctors, to find that she had been raped at times for two years by her grandfather.

title: Cardinal calling the shots in military appointments, charges Opposition MP
byline: There is a sinister move by the government to extend the term of the current army commander until January 2028 following the request of the Archbishop of Colombo Cardinal Malcolm Ranjith, Opposition MP Chamara Sampath Dassanayake charged.

title: Negombo Prison clash death toll climbs to 31 after two more officers die
byline: The death toll from the violent clashes at Negombo Prison has risen to 31 after two more prison officers died while receiving treatment at the National Hospital in Colombo.

title: Sri Lanka emerges as fastest-growing destination for Indian weddings: Report
byline: Sri Lanka has emerged as the fastest-growing overseas destination for Indian weddings in 2025, recording a 25% rise in popularity. Despite challenges posed by the ongoing West Asia crisis, couples are unlikely to scale back their destination wedding plans this year, according to a report.

title: Police probe death of man following distressing Facebook live
byline: Karandeniya Police have launched an investigation into the death of a 35-year-old man from the Thalgawatta area of Karandeniya, who died during a Facebook livestream.

title: STF Constable who died during operation posthumously promoted
byline: Police Constable D.P. Ranasinghe of the Police Special Task Force (STF), who lost his life in the Mahaweli River while taking part in an operation to apprehend suspected illegal drug traffickers, has been posthumously promoted to the rank of Sub-Inspector.

title: Asia-Pacific’s future depends on giving young people hope, says UNFPA official
byline: The future of Asia and the Pacific will be shaped not by fertility rates or population trends alone, but by whether young people have reason to hope, according to UNFPA Asia and the Pacific Regional Director Dr. Aleksandar (Sasha) Bodiroza.

title: Houthis fire missiles at Saudi Arabia, breaking years of calm
byline: Yemen’s Houthi movement fired missiles at Saudi ​Arabia after accusing the kingdom of bombing an airport under their control on Monday, breaking a four-year truce in the conflict between ‌the kingdom and the Iran-aligned group.

title: Harsha urges Colombo Mayor to repair damaged Independence Square walking path
byline: Samagi Jana Balawegaya (SJB) MP Dr. Harsha de Silva has urged the Urban Development Authority (UDA) and Colombo Mayor Vraie Cally Balthazaar to immediately repair the walking path at Independence Square, warning that its deteriorating condition poses a safety risk, particularly to elderly walkers.

title: 26-year-old arrested for allegedly killing parents in Embilipitiya
byline: A 26-year-old man has been arrested for the murder of his parents in the Kiralawellakatuwa area of Embilipitiya.

title: CAA plans pilot project for passenger-carrying drones
byline: The Civil Aviation Authority (CAA) of Sri Lanka is planning to launch a pilot project to introduce passenger-carrying drones in the country as part of efforts to explore advanced air mobility solutions.

title: UAE condemns Iran’s ’brazen’ attack on tankers as US launches fresh strikes
byline: The UAE accused Iran of a ’’brazen’’ attack on two tankers in the Strait of Hormuz on Monday, killing one and wounding eight, as Donald Trump said the US would impose a 20% charge as part of a new blockade on the waterway.

title: Norway turn World Cup heartbreak into celebration as huge crowds pack capital
byline: More than 100,000 fans flooded the streets of the Norwegian capital Oslo on ​Monday to give their soccer team a heroes’ welcome, turning the heartbreak of their World Cup exit into a ‌massive national celebration.

title: Over 70 wild elephants killed by human activities in seven months
byline: Seventy-five wild elephants have been killed due to direct human activities during the first seven months of this year, according to the Department of Wildlife Conservation.

title: Government refutes social media posts on President’s official visit to France
byline: The government today refuted social media posts that President Anura Kumara Dissanayake’s scheduled official visit to France has been postponed due to visa issues.

title: Why should President cancel France tour just because a delegation member is denied visa?: Opposition
byline: Referring to reports that President Anura Kumara Dissanayake has cancelled his tour to France as a member of the delegation has been denied a visa, Opposition MP Mujibur Rahman today questioned whether this is necessary for a cancellation of an important official tour.

title: Prime Minister to attend Qatar’s Father Emir’s funeral: Nalinda
byline: Prime Minister Harini Amarasuriya will leave for Qatar tonight to attend the funeral of Qatar’s Father Emir, His Highness Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani, Cabinet spokesman Nalinda Jayatissa said today.

title: Sri Lanka secures US$55.9 million in foreign funding to boost solar energy sector
byline: Sri Lanka is set to receive a combined foreign financing package of nearly US$55.9 million to strengthen its solar power sector and expand renewable energy access through a new ground-based solar power consolidation project.

title: Cabinet approves contract for new BIA departure terminal expansion
byline: The Cabinet of Ministers has approved the awarding of the contract for the construction of a new building with 36 check-in counters and six boarding gates at the Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA) in Katunayake, as part of efforts to expand the airport’s passenger handling capacity.

title: Kotmale Radio Academy marks 10 years of media education
byline: The Sri Lanka Broadcasting Corporation’s (SLBC) Kotmale S.L.B. Media Academy will complete 10 years of service today (July 15), having trained nearly 1,000 students through its radio education programmes.

title: New DG appointed to Government factories department
byline: The Cabinet has approved the appointment of Mr. S. N. B. M. Padmasiri, a Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Engineering Service, as the new Director General of the Department of Government Factories with immediate effect.

title: Erling Haaland carries a raccoon from US as he returns to Norway. What’s the story here?
byline: Norway’s FIFA World Cup campaign has ended, and its star footballer, Erling Haaland, has returned home to a hero’s welcome.

title: Government targets increase in average tourist spending of US$148
byline: The government is targeting a significant increase in tourist spending by 2030 as part of its strategy to strengthen Sri Lanka’s tourism industry, Deputy Minister of Tourism Ruwan Ranasinghe said.

title: Sri Lanka loses over Rs. 25 bn in cigarette tax revenue since 2025: Verité Research
byline: Sri Lanka has lost more than Rs. 25 billion in potential tax revenue since 2025 due to cigarette taxes remaining below the benchmark recommended by the World Health Organization (WHO), according to Verité Research.

title: Sri Lanka bans import of goods produced with forced labour
byline: President Anura Kumara Dissanayake, in a gazette notification, has prohibitted the importation of any goods that are mined, produced or manufactured wholly or partly by forced labour.

title: Iran executes two ISIL terrorists for armed plot
byline: Mohyeddin Abdollahi and Hossein Palani were identified as members of an ISIL cell that formed after the group’s collapse in Iraq and Syria, with the aim of rebuilding its network and carrying out attacks inside Iran. The cell had established a presence in the strategic Bamu heights along the Iran-Iraq border, where members recruited fighters, stockpiled arms and planned cross-border infiltration operations.

title: North Western Province extends Grade 6–11 second term exams due to delay in question papers
byline: The North Western Provincial Education Department has postponed part of the second term examinations for Grades 6 to 11 after delays in the printing and distribution of question papers and answer scripts.

title: Police warn public of fake GovPay websites, scam messages
byline: Sri Lanka Police have warned the public to be vigilant against fraudulent websites and text messages impersonating the official GovPay platform in an attempt to steal money from unsuspecting users.

title: Further investigations continue into alleged USD 2 million Airbus bribery scandal
byline: The Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption informed Colombo Chief Magistrate Asanga S. Bodaragama today that further investigations are being carried out into the alleged payment of a USD 2 million bribe in connection with the purchase of a fleet of ten aircraft for SriLankan Airlines in 2013 from a European aerospace company.

title: Dengue Quiz Sri Lanka: How Much Do You Really Know?
byline: Sri Lanka’s dengue outbreak has reached epidemic levels this year, with tens of thousands of cases reported nationwide. Ten questions, a few minutes, and a clearer sense of how dengue-smart you and your household really are.

title: Sri Lanka marks first with AI-assisted robotic surgeries
byline: Sri Lanka has successfully carried out its first AI-assisted robotic surgeries.

title: Overseas travel ban on former Minister Prasanna Ranatunga relaxed temporarily
byline: Colombo Chief Magistrate Asanga S. Bodaragama today temporarily relaxed the overseas travel ban imposed on former Minister Prasanna Ranatunga, who is facing proceedings over a corruption-related investigation.

title: Govt. refutes reports of VIP security for 11 individuals
byline: Cabinet Spokesman and Minister Dr. Nalinda Jayatissa today dismissed reports claiming that VIP security had been provided to 11 individuals, including several parliamentarians and monks.

title: Singapore court orders Bloomberg to pay $356,000 to ministers in defamation case
byline: A Singapore court has ordered Bloomberg and one of its reporters to pay S$460,000 ($356,000; £266,000) to two ministers who had sued them for defamation over an article referencing their property transactions.

title: New alliances between political parties in the country will fall apart – Minister Chandrasekar
byline: Minister of Fisheries Chandrasekar has stated that the new alliances formed between political parties in the country will eventually collapse.

title: The use and abuse of freedom of speech
byline: Freedom of speech is one of the pillars of a democratic society. It gives every individual the right to express opinions, exchange ideas, criticise policies, and participate in public discussions without fear. title: Several found dead in lift shaft after fire in central Brussels building
byline: Several people have died in a fire at a building under construction in Brussels on Tuesday, local authorities have said.

title: Negombo Prison officer who opened fire transferred to Pallekele
byline: The prison officer who opened fire while attempting to control the violent clash at the Negombo Prison has been temporarily transferred to the Pallekele Prison.
